name: 6563-longprompt-llama4scout-tp8
model: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct, bf16: a re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct with the same weights; the Llama 4 Community License applies.
parallelism: tp8 over the eight GPUs of one node. No PP, no DP, no EP, no router, no external cache tier; the checkpoint has 8 KV heads, so each rank takes one.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, mixture of experts, 109B total with 17B active, bf16. 48 decoder layers, 40 query and 8 key/value heads at head_dim 128. Text only: the checkpoint carries a vision tower and sglang leaves multimodal off for this architecture by default.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64 and FIXED -- do not sweep it, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. Warmup discards the first 20% and cooldown the last 15%, leaving 166 measured requests.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 90000 prompt tokens (sized so prompt plus output fits `context-length: 100000` with margin) and exactly 2048 output tokens, both stdev 0, `prefix_tokens: 0`. temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request generates its full 2048 tokens.
purpose: A long-document analysis service on eight GPUs, answering 90,000-token single-turn prompts with 2,048-token replies at 64 concurrent streams.
launch:
# A re-upload of meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct with the same weights; the Llama 4
# Community License applies. Pin the revision if the re-upload is ever republished:
# afd8e498c87bda51c7ea8ec68ea2f7c066e6340b.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct

tp-size: 8

# A declaration field and not a tunable: 90,000 prompt plus 2,048 generated tokens with room to
# spare. It is far below what the checkpoint allows.
context-length: 100000

mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Pinned rather than left to the engine's own choice, so the run does not depend on what the
# default resolves to on this device.
attention-backend: fa3

disable-radix-cache: true

# Set high enough never to bind, matching the offered streams. It also truncates the CUDA graph
# capture ladder at 64 rather than the 512 this device would otherwise derive, which is worth
# several minutes of startup on a 48-layer MoE.
max-running-requests: 64
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
